# Module `webcodecs_codec`

WebCodecs encoded chunks and AudioData (src/page/webcodecs_chunks.odin, native/js/runtime/web_webcodecs_codec.c).
EncodedVideoChunk / EncodedAudioChunk are immutable coded samples; AudioData is decoded PCM with planar / interleaved
copyTo. All the layouts and conversions are native.

Exposed to: Window, Worker. Source: `api/webcodecs_codec.widl`.

## Types

### handle `EncodedVideoChunk` : `Object`

Checked by the browser on every call (`lookup_EncodedVideoChunk`).

### handle `EncodedAudioChunk` : `Object`

Checked by the browser on every call (`lookup_EncodedAudioChunk`).

### handle `AudioData` : `Object`

Checked by the browser on every call (`lookup_AudioData`).

### enum `AudioSampleFormat` : i32

The WebCodecs AudioSampleFormat enum, in the order webcodecs_chunks.odin's Audio_Sample_Format uses (format()
returns -1 for a closed AudioData, which the engine maps to null).

| member | value | |
|---|---:|---|
| `None` | 0 |  |%!(EXTRA false)
| `U8` | 1 |  |%!(EXTRA false)
| `S16` | 2 |  |%!(EXTRA false)
| `S32` | 3 |  |%!(EXTRA false)
| `F32` | 4 |  |%!(EXTRA false)
| `U8_Planar` | 5 |  |%!(EXTRA false)
| `S16_Planar` | 6 |  |%!(EXTRA false)
| `S32_Planar` | 7 |  |%!(EXTRA false)
| `F32_Planar` | 8 |  |%!(EXTRA false)
